figures.title: Seeing a Vision Transformer through learning images
figures.caption_zh: 同一输入经过正常前向计算得到预测；NNS-ViT 为内部目标与输出目标提供保留输入位置的学习图像。虚线表示目标与学习图像的对应关系。
figures.caption_en: The same input produces a prediction through the ordinary forward computation. NNS-ViT associates internal and output targets with learning images in the original input coordinates. Dashed lines link targets to their images.

figures.title: A neuron value and its learning image are computed together
figures.caption_zh: 同一四坐标网络的正常数值计算与 NNS-ViT 学习图像传播。节点与对应学习图像使用同色标记；下方矩阵保留各输入项的位置，并按上方网络的局部系数组合。
figures.caption_en: Ordinary scalar computation and NNS-ViT learning-image propagation in the same four-coordinate network. Matching colors link nodes to learning images; lower matrices preserve input positions and combine with the graph coefficients.

figures.title: Initialization: split the input, then assign one image to each coordinate
figures.caption_zh: 初始化分为拆分与分配两步：输入矩阵被拆成四张稀疏坐标图，并按同色虚线分配给四个输入节点。每张图同时保存输入值与其位置。
figures.caption_en: Initialization has two steps: split the input into four sparse coordinate images and assign them to input nodes using matching colored links. Each image preserves both value and position.

figures.title: Generation: collect every input path to the selected target
figures.caption_zh: 中间网络以灰色显示，红色虚线路径突出每个输入坐标到目标的合成局部系数。右下矩阵是四张输入 learning images 的加权和，与输入乘目标梯度一致。
figures.caption_en: The intermediate graph is muted while red dashed paths highlight composed local coefficients from every input coordinate to the target. The lower-right matrix is the weighted sum of input learning images and equals input times target gradient.

figures.title: Patch embedding is a local projection and a sparse global linear map
figures.caption_zh: 左栏以真实图像说明 patch embedding 的局部投影；右栏将同一运算写成全局输入上的稀疏线性行。橙色区域在 token、稀疏权重与 learning-image support 之间一一对应。
figures.caption_en: The left panel shows native patch projection on a real image; the right expresses the same operation as a sparse row over global input coordinates. The orange region corresponds across token support, sparse weights and learning-image support.

figures.title: Attention separates routing from value transmission
figures.caption_zh: Q/K 的变化通过 attention weights 改变 routing；V 的变化通过当前权重传播。两条微分路径相加重构完整 attention 微分，head 下游 cotangent 包含 output projection。
figures.caption_en: Q/K changes alter routing through attention weights; V changes propagate through the current weights. The two differential paths sum to the full attention differential, with output projection included in the downstream cotangent.

figures.title: Residual connections preserve an identity path and add a transformed path
figures.caption_zh: 上方显示 residual 的 identity 与 branch 两条真实计算边；下方用同色虚线连接到同一输入、同一类别目标的路径 learning images。完整 signed maps 相加得到 residual output，蓝底正部用于阅读空间结构。
figures.caption_en: The upper graph shows the native identity and branch edges; matching dashed links connect them to path learning images for the same input and class target. Complete signed maps add to the residual output, while blue positive views display spatial structure.

figures.title: Different targets reveal different parts of the same input
figures.caption_zh: 同一图像的不同内部与类别目标。Energy targets 使用前向空间方差最大的通道；这与单个 token-channel 目标和最终类别目标区分。
figures.caption_en: Different internal and class targets for one image. Energy targets use the channel of highest forward spatial variance and are distinct from individual token-channel and final class targets.

figures.title: DeiT-S/16: learning images through all twelve blocks
figures.caption_zh: 同一懒熊输入跨全部 12 层的学习图像及真实前向特征。每层通道按前向空间方差选择；上排为该通道 energy scalar 的输入图，下排为该通道原生 14×14 activation 的正部。各面板独立缩放。
figures.caption_en: Learning images and actual forward features across all 12 blocks for the same sloth-bear input. Each block selects a channel by forward spatial variance. The upper row shows its energy-target input map, and the lower row the positive native 14×14 activation. Panels are independently scaled.

figures.title: ViT-B/16: learning images through all twelve blocks
figures.caption_zh: 同一懒熊输入跨全部 12 层的学习图像及真实前向特征。每层通道按前向空间方差选择；上排为该通道 energy scalar 的输入图，下排为该通道原生 14×14 activation 的正部。各面板独立缩放。
figures.caption_en: Learning images and actual forward features across all 12 blocks for the same sloth-bear input. Each block selects a channel by forward spatial variance. The upper row shows its energy-target input map, and the lower row the positive native 14×14 activation. Panels are independently scaled.

figures.title: Inside a block: normalization, attention and the MLP
figures.caption_zh: DeiT-S blocks 0、5、11 内部模块的学习图像和真实前向 activation。每个模块独立选择高空间方差通道并定义 energy target；LayerNorm、attention projection、MLP 的 fc1/GELU/fc2 清楚对应。
figures.caption_en: Learning images and actual forward activations inside DeiT-S blocks 0, 5 and 11. Each module independently selects a high-spatial-variance channel and defines an energy target, covering LayerNorm, attention projection and MLP fc1/GELU/fc2.

figures.title: Spatial dependence broadens with depth
figures.caption_zh: 完整 cohort 的图像级层深轨迹，阴影为 95% bootstrap 区间。空间分析每模型 100 图，attention/residual 每模型 400 图；推断沿用原冻结分析。
figures.caption_en: Image-level depth trajectories from the full cohorts, with 95% bootstrap intervals. Spatial analyses use 100 images per model and attention/residual analyses 400; inference follows the original analysis.

figures.title: Attention heads distribute dependence differently
figures.caption_zh: DeiT-S 在 blocks 0、5、11 的全部六个 heads，对同一个 ground-truth logit 的输入依赖图。原图逐行保留，无按地图观感筛选 head。
figures.caption_en: All six DeiT-S heads at blocks 0, 5 and 11, conditioned on the same ground-truth logit. Each row retains the original image, and no heads are selected by visual appearance.

figures.title: Class-target learning images across two models
figures.caption_zh: 三个主体可辨的展示样本及两模型的同类别 Endpoint。样本为展示选择，模型间颜色强度不作为量值比较。
figures.caption_en: Three presentation-selected images with recognizable subjects and same-class Endpoints from both models. Color intensities are not used for cross-model magnitude comparisons.

figures.title: Routing and value on the same image and class target
figures.caption_zh: 同一懒熊输入在浅层和深层的 Q、K、routing 与 value 路径。蓝底保留正部细节；signed closure 和绝对质量来自完整原始 arrays。
figures.caption_en: Q, K, routing and value paths at early and late blocks for the same sloth-bear image. Blue displays retain positive detail; signed closure and absolute masses use complete original arrays.

figures.title: Deep attention departs from Value-only propagation
figures.caption_zh: 完整 cohort 的图像级层深轨迹，阴影为 95% bootstrap 区间。空间分析每模型 100 图，attention/residual 每模型 400 图；推断沿用原冻结分析。
figures.caption_en: Image-level depth trajectories from the full cohorts, with 95% bootstrap intervals. Spatial analyses use 100 images per model and attention/residual analyses 400; inference follows the original analysis.

figures.title: Two residual sublayers, one downstream target
figures.caption_zh: 同一 block 5 中 attention 与 MLP residual 对同一类别目标的两条路径。两行的 identity 指向不同 residual 输入边。正部图不可直接相加，完整 signed maps 满足闭合。
figures.caption_en: Attention and MLP residual paths in block 5 for the same class target. The identity paths refer to different residual input edges. Positive displays are not additive; the complete signed maps satisfy closure.

figures.title: Attention and MLP residuals follow distinct trends
figures.caption_zh: 完整 cohort 的图像级层深轨迹，阴影为 95% bootstrap 区间。空间分析每模型 100 图，attention/residual 每模型 400 图；推断沿用原冻结分析。
figures.caption_en: Image-level depth trajectories from the full cohorts, with 95% bootstrap intervals. Spatial analyses use 100 images per model and attention/residual analyses 400; inference follows the original analysis.

figures.title: DeiT-S/16: learning images and other visual explanations
figures.caption_zh: 同输入实际计算的 Endpoint、patch-max 显示变体、Grad-CAM、attention rollout 与 raw attention。Endpoint/Grad-CAM 使用同一 GT logit；后两种 attention 方法不依赖类别。所有图采用相同蓝底色系并独立归一化，只比较表示形态与粒度。
figures.caption_en: Actual same-input Endpoint, its patch-max display variant, Grad-CAM, attention rollout and raw attention. Endpoint/Grad-CAM use the same GT logit; attention methods are class-agnostic. A common blue palette and independent normalization compare spatial form and granularity, not quantitative superiority.

figures.title: ViT-B/16: learning images and other visual explanations
figures.caption_zh: 同输入实际计算的 Endpoint、patch-max 显示变体、Grad-CAM、attention rollout 与 raw attention。Endpoint/Grad-CAM 使用同一 GT logit；后两种 attention 方法不依赖类别。所有图采用相同蓝底色系并独立归一化，只比较表示形态与粒度。 Figure 20 的三例在计算比较方法前，已按预先封存的 Endpoint/输入细节可读性规则选定。
figures.caption_en: Actual same-input Endpoint, its patch-max display variant, Grad-CAM, attention rollout and raw attention. Endpoint/Grad-CAM use the same GT logit; attention methods are class-agnostic. A common blue palette and independent normalization compare spatial form and granularity, not quantitative superiority. Figure 20 examples were selected by the presealed Endpoint/input-detail readability rule before comparison methods were computed.

figures.title: Spatial intervention evaluates a different property
figures.caption_zh: 左侧示例的有限区域替换曲线与右侧完整 400 图 family 的绝对 AUC。候选 oracle 只在已评价区域集合中取最优；数学闭合与区域干预选择属于不同性质。
figures.caption_en: Finite region-replacement curves for the example and absolute AUC over complete 400-image families. The candidate oracle is restricted to evaluated region sets; mathematical closure and spatial intervention selection measure different properties.

figures.title: Reading positive structure without discarding signed information
figures.caption_zh: 同一原始图的蓝底正部、signed 与 RGB absolute mass 三种视图。正部用于读取空间细节，signed 保留方向，absolute 保留通道抵消前的总幅值。
figures.caption_en: Blue positive, signed and RGB absolute-mass views of the same original arrays. The positive view displays spatial detail, signed maps retain direction, and absolute maps preserve magnitude before channel cancellation.
